title: Flaky: TelemetryHookScriptTests pwsh hook process does not exit within 30 seconds on Windows
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Cli.Tests, Cli, Cli, tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests.cs... / Cli (windows-latest)
error_pattern: System.TimeoutException : Hook process 'pwsh' did not exit within 30 seconds.
analysis: The test spawns an external pwsh process and waits up to 30 seconds for it to exit; the failure is a timeout waiting on an external process rather than an assertion on behavior changed by the PR. The PR under test (#20039) only adds a new sync workflow and its infrastructure test/harness files, and does not touch Aspire.Cli or the TelemetryHookScriptTests area, so this timeout is unrelated to the PR changes and indicates environment/process-launch flakiness on the Windows runner.
